lesson.title: Procedure 300 – Shift Change & Unit Designations
objectives: Understand how sector cars and response autos are designated and assigned during shift change.
Correctly identify Neighborhood Coordination Officer (NCO) designations and when they should or should not be assigned.
Apply proper naming conventions for foot posts, special posts, precinct special resources, and public safety units.
Correctly designate Housing Bureau resources and Transit Bureau resources at shift change.
Use All Out (AO) and Transit unit designations in accordance with CAD conventions.

questions.stem: According to Procedure 300, which type of unit should be assigned first to 10-11s, 10-22 GLAs, and 10-53 property damage only jobs?

choices.text: Sector cars in the sector of occurrence

questions.solution: Response Autos are assigned to 10-11s, 10-22 GLAs, 10-53 property damage only, and certain 10-54s before the sector concerned.

questions.stem: Sector cars may respond to 10-11s even when a Response Auto is available and not on assignment.
When incidents are pending and the sector concerned is on assignment with no Response Autos available, the dispatcher should assign the event to the adjacent ______.
Match each unit type or rule with the correct description under Procedure 300.
answer: Handles jobs only in its own sector unless no other resource is available
Assigned first to certain low-level emergency events such as 10-11, 10-22 GLA, 10-53 property damage
Receives jobs when the sector concerned is on assignment and no Response Autos are available
Receives high-priority incidents when no units are available including Response Autos
Sectors A1, B1, C1, etc. at shift change

questions.stem: How are precinct Neighborhood Coordination Officer (NCO) units designated in CAD?

choices.text: 9NCOA1, 9NCOB1, etc., where the number indicates the precinct and letter indicates the sector

questions.solution: Example in the guide: 9NCOA1, 9NCOB1, etc., where the NCO designations include the sector.

questions.stem: When a precinct or transit NCO is in the rundown at shift change, the dispatcher should routinely raise them for assignments the same as any other unit.
When an NCO unit requests to be designated "OFF Radio Time" or "Community Time," the dispatcher must create an event using radio signal code 10-____C.
Match each NCO-related designation or rule with the correct description.
answer: Precinct NCO unit patrolling A sector of the 9th Precinct
Transit NCO unit patrolling A sector in Transit District 12
Instruction when NCO units are in the rundown
Radio signal code used when NCO is on OFF Radio/Community Time
All NCO units logged with platoon
Rule: all NCO/RES units must be logged with a platoon identifier, never as unknown

questions.stem: At Central Park Precinct, how is a sector car that covers sectors “A” and “B” designated?
questions.solution: Procedure 300 states that sector cars are designated by the lowest alphabetical sector being covered.

questions.stem: When a sector in Central Park has multiple RMPs assigned, those units are designated A1, A2, A3.
At Central Park Precinct, when a sector has more than one RMP assigned, units are designated as sectors “A”, “_____”, and “_____”.
Match each Central Park-specific designation with its meaning.
answer: Sector A covering A and B
The unit is designated as sector “A”
Use lowest alphabetical sector being covered

questions.stem: A foot post covering posts 1, 2, 3, and 4 must be designated as:
questions.solution: Foot officers on patrol posts are designated by the lowest post number being covered.

questions.stem: The system will accept foot post numbers from PP1 up to PP124.
Scooters on patrol in the precinct will be input as SC1 through SC____.
Match each post type with its correct designation format.
Which SP designation is used for the Robbery Car / Robberies in Progress?
questions.solution: SP6 is the Robbery Car / RIP (Robberies in Progress).

questions.stem: SP45 is designated for a Domestic Violence Officer (DVO).
Multiple traffic assignments can be designated as SP3 Summons Auto, SP32 Red Light Auto, and SP33 ______ Safety.
Match each SP designation to its function.
answer: Burglary Car / Print Car / BAT (Burglary Apprehension Team)
Summons / Traffic / Red Light / Pedestrian Safety
Precinct Resource / Resource Cars / Quality of Life
Example of expanding SP designations up to 9

questions.stem: How are precinct Public Safety units on patrol generally designated?
questions.solution: Procedure 300 states that Public Safety units will turn out as PS1–5 from each precinct/PSA.

questions.stem: The designation “ST” can be used for any supervisor, including lieutenants, assigned to a precinct.
According to Procedure 300, “ST” will only be used for uniformed ______.
Match each PS/ST designation with the correct description.
answer: Public Safety units on patrol turning out of every precinct/PSA
Example of a Public Safety unit from the 42nd Precinct
Public Safety Sergeant from the 42nd Precinct
Public Safety Lieutenant from the 42nd Precinct
Primary sergeant of the precinct concerned (can include sergeant’s driver)

questions.stem: How is a Housing Team Post designated in CAD?

choices.text: HTA followed by the post number
HTP followed by the post number (e.g., 77HTP1)
IRT followed by the post number
AO followed by the post number

questions.stem: Housing Team Autos are input as HTA followed by a four-digit RMP/VAN number.
Housing Impact Response Teams are input as IRT followed by the ______ number (e.g., 73IRT27).
Match each Housing Bureau designation with its description.
answer: Housing Team Auto, HTA + 4-digit RMP/VAN number (e.g., 77HTA9892)

questions.stem: When an incident occurs in a Housing location covered by specific patrol posts, which units should the dispatcher assign first?

choices.text: The nearest RMP regardless of designation
The Patrol Posts assigned to that housing location

questions.solution: Procedure 300 says dispatchers must assign events in housing locations first to the patrol posts assigned to that location.

questions.stem: Solo Foot Posts in housing may be teamed up to handle events that require a dual response.
For Hammel Houses (100 PCT), Procedure 300 lists foot posts 32–34 as geographically close enough to be ______ up.
Match each housing location with its posts as listed in Procedure 300.
answer: Assign only to appropriate jobs; can be teamed up for dual response

questions.stem: Which of the following is correctly matched as a Transit assignment designation?
questions.solution: FXP1 is the Transit Tunnel Post Fixed code in Procedure 300.

questions.stem: GT1 is the designation for a Transit Gang Team and GL1 is for a Transit Green Line Team.
RES1 is the designation used for Transit ______ Auto.
Match each Transit designation to its correct description.

questions.topic: Transit Unit Naming & All Out (AO) Posts
questions.stem: How would a Transit District 1 mobile car be entered in CAD at shift change?
questions.solution: Procedure 300 gives D1A as the example of District 1 mobile car.

questions.topic: Transit Unit Naming & All Out (AO) Posts
questions.stem: Summer All Out Posts in Transit District 4 are designated as D4AO21–D4AO30.

questions.topic: Transit Unit Naming & All Out (AO) Posts
questions.stem: A Transit City Wide unit from District 1 is designated as D1_____.

questions.topic: Transit Unit Naming & All Out (AO) Posts
questions.stem: Match each Transit unit naming rule or example with its description.
answer: District 32 Transit unit using District number + unit ID (SP6)
Transit Dispatcher must use AO designations already in CAD along with the shift identifier
